construct: Invariant preservation under adversarial inputs paired with benign near-neighbors across filesystem paths, sidecar argument builders, URL/SSRF redirect checks, .torrent manifests, 1 MiB IPC framing, and multi-step HTTP download chains (socket drop, SQLite WAL pause/reopen resume, 403 expiry + URL refresh, If-Range ETag validation, SHA-256 oracle, Windows Mark-of-the-Web ADS, zero orphan temp files).
contamination_defense: Programmatic combinatorial generation with canonical-key deduplication enforcing 100% unique items across all single-input slices (>= 1,200) and orthogonal factorial stateful chains (108), separated from crate unit-test fixtures.

difficulty_audit.construct_preserving_scaling: Includes boundary 200-byte/201-byte filenames, Windows reserved DOS device names with extensions, Unicode BiDi isolate/override codepoints, URL-encoded & multi-segment paths, IPv4-mapped IPv6/CGNAT addresses, multi-file UTF-8 torrent layouts, 1 MiB IPC boundaries, and orthogonal 5-factor stateful chaos HTTP chains.
difficulty_audit.broken_item_check: Every item is checked by an independent deterministic oracle (byte-for-byte SHA-256, NTFS Zone.Identifier ADS inspection, directory orphan scan, strict JSONL schema); crashes, panics, or timeouts emit broken=true and abort if excluded_rate exceeds max_grader_error_rate.
